slices.title: root-rewrite-vocabulary-and-negative-corpus
slices.summary: Recorded the accepted ten-class root rewrite vocabulary as semantic-only data, with exact proof obligations, carrier policies, one compound-carrier exemplar, pressure roles, and fail-closed blocked/composed cases. Focused tests and repository typecheck pass; approved even-root presentation is unchanged.

slices.title: verified-root-rewrite-plans
slices.summary: Added a nominal data-driven root plan compiler. Per-class declarations own exact roles, proof obligations, prior-operation requirements, and derived persist/consume/introduce/fuse/retain-enclosure dispositions; blocked laws return typed gaps, composed derivations remain sequence-only, carrier identity mismatches fail closed, and presentation fields are rejected. Twenty-three focused root/inverse tests and full typecheck pass.

slices.title: recursive-root-endpoint-roles
slices.summary: Added a bounded root-specific recursive Native KaTeX endpoint protocol for token, sequence, grouping, power, radical, and absolute-value nodes. Every semantic occurrence receives one nested selector and presentation group with explicit parent identity; compound carriers preserve child identities, unsafe/repeated nodes fail closed, and the existing even-root path remains green. Thirteen focused endpoint/plan/transit tests and full typecheck pass.

slices.title: compound-carrier-semantics
slices.summary: Built the verified sqrt((x+1)^2) to abs(x+1) semantic exemplar. Principal-root normalization now requires explicit real-valued-carrier evidence. A nominal deep-subtree certificate proves ordered identity for the carrier, x, plus, and one while keeping source/target representation entities distinct; the absolute-value enclosure is introduced, not falsely persisted. Fifteen focused tests and full typecheck pass; no rendering or timing changed.

slices.title: compound-carrier-native-realization
slices.summary: Compiled the verified compound-carrier root rewrite into one canonical Native KaTeX compositor session. The complete x+1 subtree persists as one opaque carrier without material scaling; radical, grouping, and exponent syntax withdraw in place; separately owned absolute-value delimiters enter through canonical horizontal function-wrap reception. Deterministic direct seek, exact endpoints, recursive ownership, and full typecheck pass without a new clock, renderer, or caller-authored geometry.

slices.title: compound-carrier-visual-checkpoint
slices.summary: Human approved the revised compound-carrier checkpoint. The certified x+1 descendants share one semantic motion unit and clock, resolve measured local-layout residuals, and settle at exact native target ink before ownership handoff. Focused semantic and Chromium geometry checks pass; promotion may proceed to the bounded root pressure callers.

slices.title: closed-multiglyph-evaluation-pressure
slices.summary: Added a verified sqrt(144) to 12 pressure exemplar with strict arithmetic evidence, recursive Native KaTeX endpoints, and a shared closed-evaluation fusion projection extracted from the approved even-root ink-knot grammar. Four measured source ink owners contract to one target-derived knot, two result glyphs expand and settle at native endpoints, incomplete recursive paint fails closed, direct seek is deterministic, and approved even-root and compound-root callers remain green. Repository typecheck still reports only the separately recorded compositor union and stale observer-type baseline errors.

slices.title: odd-root-pressure-caller
slices.summary: Added the verified x cubed equals eight to x equals cube-root eight pressure caller. The existing inverse-power verifier proves odd parity, one unique real branch, complete candidate audit, and no plus-minus. Recursive endpoints give the visible root index its own owner; the source exponent crosses equality on a protected arc and settles as that native index, while radical reception shares an explicit contact group with the index and radicand. Nineteen focused checks and architecture gates pass, with deterministic seek and no changes to approved callers.

slices.title: rational-exponent-composition-pressure
slices.summary: Added the verified cube-root of x-squared to x-to-the-two-thirds composition pressure caller. The compiler-owned root plan persists x, fuses the source index and exponent into one target exponent, and consumes the radical; leaf correspondence independently preserves 2 as numerator and 3 as denominator while introducing only the division glyph. Recursive endpoints, compositor-owned routing, exact settlement, deterministic reverse/direct seek, focused root tests, and architecture gates pass without a new fraction renderer or caller geometry.
